annotations.title: Analyst rating changes, surprises and revisions

description: A stock's analyst history from Yahoo Finance: every upgrade, downgrade, initiation and target change by firm over any window, the last four quarters' earnings surprises, how the EPS estimate moved over 90 days with the analysts revising it up and down, and the rating counts month by month. stock_snapshot has today's targets and estimates. A vendor's aggregates, labeled so.

days.description: Rating changes over this many days; default 180.

firm.description: Only this firm's rating changes (part of its name).

symbol.description: The ticker on Yahoo Finance: AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T.

name: analyst_history

outputSchema.description: Each block is a table: rating changes newest first; surprises, revisions and recommendations by period.
